sloka: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे ।रामे दुःखाभिभूते तु लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते ।। ५.६७.२६ ।।।।
transliteration: tvacchokavimukho rāmo devi satyena te śape ।rāme duḥkhābhibhūte tu lakṣmaṇaḥ paritapyate ।। 5.67.26 ।।।।

translations.english: "In this very moment, radiant lady, you shall see the end of your sorrows. Those two tigers among men, princes and scorchers of foes,
